codeSpace: A left-right mirror-symmetric ring code has 21 independent values (the ring's 40 cells sit at 21 distinct angles from straight up). Orders 0-20 of a0 + sum a_n cos(n theta) span all of them, with a well-conditioned basis (condition number 5.1); order 21 adds nothing (rank stays 21). So orders 0-20 at ceiling 2.0 is the whole mirror-symmetric code space, and the ladder cannot go further without leaving it.

ladder.settings: stop: no mirror-symmetric ring code of any order, at the physical ceiling, has been found to form the stripes by this search. The report is then the negative result with every rung's scores and controls. Relaxing mirror symmetry (sine terms), the hold length or the tissue is a new design and needs the user's decision.

stopCondition: the first rung at which G1 (a restart with stripe overlap >= 0.9 at its best moment) and G2 (that code's score at least 5 mV below the best of 64 random allowed codes of its size, scored by the same summary script) both hold. Escalation stops there. The rung is recorded and Stages 2-4 proceed with that code. If two or more codes qualify, the one with the lowest score is used and the others are reported.
reportingRules: Every rung that was run is reported with its arms, restarts, best scores and overlaps, not only the rung that succeeded, and the report says how many codes were simulated before the stripe was found.

S1-S8 are evaluated as registered. S2 (the smallest contiguous size with overlap >= 0.9 is <= 2) is judged on every size actually searched; a stripe found only at an order above 6, or only at ceiling 2.0, is reported as such and S2 is then recorded as failed. S3-S5 are judged on the arms they name (pilot, and the registered full run); arms of rung 4 are descriptive.

G1 is an existence claim about this tissue and code, checked by replay (V3), not a hypothesis test, so successive rungs are not corrected for; the random-code control (G2, C1) is rerun at the size and ceiling of any code that is to carry the later stages.
Anything about the extended rungs beyond G1, G2 and these counts is labelled exploratory.
